explanation_excerpt: Skills are files under skills/ organized by category. Each has a SKILL.md with instructions. The pack can be installed to different AI tools and each one picks up the skills from its own director

gaps.description: Omits the dual-format distribution model: agentskills.io portable format (skills/) versus Claude Code plugin format (.claude-plugin/ with hooks, agents, MCP servers).
Does not mention that skills/ is the source of truth and .claude-plugin/ contains symlinks generated by npm run build.
No mention of the installed MCP servers (surreal-memory, sycophancy-correction, Cortex, Dify KB) that ship alongside the skills.
Omits that new skills are picked up via /reload-plugins (Claude Code) or on next session start (other platforms) without requiring a restart.
gaps.corpus_ref: MISCONCEPTION: you have to restart Claude to use new skills

gaps.description: No mention of required SKILL.md frontmatter fields or the scripts/references/assets standard directories.

transfer_problems: A teammate edits a file inside .claude-plugin/skills/ directly, expecting the change to persist after the next npm run build. Explain what will actually happen and why.

A new skill is added to skills/react/ but a teammate says it won't be usable until they restart their entire machine. Using the pack's install and reload mechanism, explain what is actually required for the skill to become available in Claude Code versus another supported platform.
